Name: Spoilage Mod
Author: SomeRandomDude3321
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Spoilage Mod - Realistic Food Rot & Composting[/b]

Tired of fish and food sitting in chests for years without going bad? SpoilageMod introduces a realistic, performance-friendly global rotting mechanic to Stardew Valley, complete with an eco-friendly recycling system to turn your waste into high-tier fertilizers!
Inspired by Factorio space age btw.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]The Rotting Mechanics[/b]
Every night, food items left out in normal chests or in your backpack have a random chance to spoil based on their shelf-life category:
Fish: 1 Day (100% chance to rot overnight)
Cooked Food: 3 Days (~33% chance overnight)
Fruit: 7 Days (~14% chance overnight)
Vegetables: 14 Days (~7% chance overnight)

[b]The Fridge isn't a Fraud[/b]
Need to keep your ingredients fresh? Any food stored inside your Kitchen Fridge or a Mini-Fridge is completely safe from the elements and will never spoil!

[b]The Composter Machine[/b]
Don't let your spoiled food go to waste! Craft the brand-new **Composter** machine (unlocked automatically in your crafting menu for 50 Wood and 1 Iron Bar) to recycle your waste:
Put in 10x Low/Silver Quality Spoiled Organics -> Yields Basic Fertilizer
Put in 10x Gold/Iridium Quality Spoiled Organics -> Yields Deluxe Fertilizer[/color]

Don't worry it won't lag. and enjoy suffering.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Just do it normally[/color][/size]
